free_bend_comparison_01.command:
python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool free-center-bend --memory-gib 1 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/free_bend_comparison_01 -- python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
def readings(name, mesh):
    run = Path('"'"'_scratch/s11c'"'"')/f'"'"'{name}_{mesh}_01'"'"'
    result = json.loads((run/'"'"'outcome.json'"'"').read_text())
    guard = json.loads((run/'"'"'limit-validation.json'"'"').read_text())
    assert result['"'"'exitCode'"'"']==result['"'"'childOutcome'"'"']['"'"'exitCode'"'"']==0 and result['"'"'limitsVerified'"'"']
    assert guard['"'"'verified'"'"'] and guard['"'"'actual'"'"']['"'"'memory.swap.max'"'"']=='"'"'0'"'"'
    return list(map(json.loads,(run/'"'"'stdout'"'"').read_text().splitlines()))
for mesh in ('"'"'n26_compact'"'"','"'"'n34_wide'"'"'):
    cert=readings('"'"'free_bend_certificate'"'"',mesh)
    ev=[r for r in cert if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'energy_curvature'"'"']
    assert all(r['"'"'field_quadrature_floor'"'"']>0 for r in ev)
    assert ev[0]['"'"'relaxed_curvatures'"'"'][1]<0<ev[1]['"'"'relaxed_curvatures'"'"'][0]
    m=next(r for r in cert if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'mode'"'"' and r['"'"'area_tension'"'"']==0 and r['"'"'real'"'"']>.1 and r['"'"'imag'"'"']>0)
    p=[r for r in cert if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'short_pulse'"'"']
    h=readings('"'"'free_bend_held'"'"',mesh)
    d=readings('"'"'free_bend_incident'"'"',mesh)
    inertia=readings('"'"'free_bend_inertia'"'"',mesh)
    a=[]
    for tension in (.02,.04):
        force=next(r['"'"'force_per_speed'"'"'] for r in h if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'relaxed_held'"'"' and r['"'"'drive'"'"']=='"'"'brane'"'"' and r['"'"'tension'"'"']==tension)
        dc=next(r['"'"'force_per_stream'"'"'] for r in d if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'dc_holder'"'"' and r['"'"'tension'"'"']==tension)
        assert abs(force+dc)<1e-9
        mass=next(r['"'"'total'"'"'] for r in inertia if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'entrance_inertia'"'"' and r['"'"'tension'"'"']==tension)
        driven=next(r for r in d if r['"'"'test'"'"']=='"'"'free_incident'"'"' and r['"'"'omega'"'"']==.005 and r['"'"'tension'"'"']==tension)
        a.append(driven['"'"'entrance_and_flare_real'"'"'][0])
        print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=mesh,tension=tension,held=force,slow_mass=mass,held_per_mass=force/mass,direct_omega005=a[-1],static_holder_residual=force+dc)))
    print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=mesh,modal_real=m['"'"'real'"'"'],modal_imag=m['"'"'imag'"'"'],e_fold=1/m['"'"'real'"'"'],mode_residual=m['"'"'full_relative_residual'"'"'],acceleration_change_percent=100*(a[1]/a[0]-1),max_short_pulse_work_error=max(max(r['"'"'relative_error'"'"']) for r in p))))'
